messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Smart-routing detected a fallback loop for model group 'chatx-large' -> quant variants bouncing between us-west-2 and eu-west-1, elevated 5xx and tool_call failures. SRE on-call: @ops-oncall. Auto-created channel: #inc-2031428571
ops-oncall: I'm on it. First look: spikes started ~2031428400, correlated with deploy of routing-policy v3.7. Rolling impact: customer-facing requests intermittently failing tool calls (function/tool calling). Marking P1.
kira: Saw the same in the traces — requests hit quantized variant, then were routed to eu due to capacity, then fell back to quant again. The quant variant returns "unsupported_tool_call" for calls that fp16 handles.
sanjay: logs excerpt: ```ERROR 2031428460 route=smart-route id=req-9c2 tool_call_status=unsupported_tool_call variant=chatx-large-q8 context_len=4096 allowed=8192 region=eu-west-1
ERROR 2031428461 route=smart-route id=req-9c3 fallback=region-handoff -> variant=chatx-large-q8 -> error=unsupported_tool_call
```
devon: Quick mitigation: we can flip the routing policy to prefer fp16 variant for tool_call capability or set quant variant weight=0 for the hotpath. I'll post the command I used in staging.
ops-oncall: What's the minimal blast radius? Which customers affected?
mia: Support noticed 3 enterprise customers with increased errors: AcmeChat (high), NovaDocs (med), internal smoke tests. Acme is seeing 20% failed tool responses; they opened a support ticket.
jordan: We should notify Acme with a brief blameless note: "we're investigating, temporary mitigation in progress". @devon can you draft?
devon: Draft: "Hi Acme team — we detected some requests hitting a quantized model variant that doesn't fully support tool calling. We're applying a routing policy change that will steer tool-calls to the fp16 model. This is temporary; we'll follow with a root-cause update." happy to send after ops confirmation. :thumbsup:
kira: Proposed hotfix (in-control-plane): ```
# temporary policy patch
redwoodctl routing patch --policy-id smart-route --set "rule[tool_call].preferred_variants=[\"chatx-large-fp16\"]" --reason "incident 2031428571: disable q variants for tool_call"
```
sanjay: Alternative (immediate): kubectl exec into routing-config and set quant weight to 0 for rule 'hotpath-toolcall': ```PATCH /configs/smart-route
{
  "rules": {
    "hotpath-toolcall": { "variant_weights": { "chatx-large-q8": 0, "chatx-large-fp16": 100 } }
  }
}
```
ops-oncall: I'm going to apply the redwoodctl change now (will run as dry-run then apply). Executing in 60s.
ops-oncall: (executed) `redwoodctl routing patch ...` -> response: 200 OK, policy version 3.8. Rolling update triggered.
ops-oncall: Metrics update: tail error-rate for tool_call on smart-route down from 18% -> 3% in 90s. Latency stable. :tada:
kira: Nice. We should also patch the compatibility matrix so future routing decisions consider tool_call capability of quant variants explicitly. I found the entry missing: chatx-large-q8 lacked tool_call=true/false metadata.
devon: File to update: /configs/compat-matrix/models.yml — I can open PR but we should hotpatch first. Proposed entry snippet: `chatx-large-q8: { tool_calling: false, max_context: 4096 }`
sanjay: Agree. Also need to ensure the smart-routing decision engine reads 'tool_calling' from metadata before selecting variant. That's why fallback loop happened: router picks variant based on cost/latency, not capability.
mia: Customer comms ready: "Mitigation applied, steering to fp16, minimal expected customer impact, follow-up within 24h." Want ops to send?
ops-oncall: I'll ping accounts and send the notice to Acme. @jordan please coordinate.
jordan: On it. I'll cc account team and include mitigation and ETA for full fix.
pagerduty-bot: Handoff assigned to @kira for next shift at 2031428800. Reminder: don't forget to add postmortem link once created.
kira: Handoff ack. I'll own the RCA and postmortem. Immediate next steps: 1) ensure policy patch is durable (control plane persists change) 2) update compat-matrix and PR it 3) add a router guard: refuse to route tool_call requests to variants with tool_calling=false 4) run regression tests for context-length mismatches.
sanjay: I'll add a temporary guard in router config: `if request.tool_call and variant.tool_calling == false then skip_variant` and push in 10m as hotfix.
ops-oncall: Done: guard rolled out to 3 routing instances, no errors. Monitoring shows no more loops.
mia: Sent customer notice to Acme and NovaDocs — copied remediation and expected follow-up. Acme replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted."
devon: For audit: capture the policy diff: ```diff
- chatx-large-q8: { tool_calling: ? }
+ chatx-large-q8: { tool_calling: false, max_context: 4096 }
```
kira: Postmortem owners: @kira (RCA lead), @sanjay (runtime fix), @devon (policy + compat-matrix). ETA: 48 hours for draft.
ops-oncall: Closing pager for now, but keeping the channel open for follow-ups. Will hand to kira at shift change. Thanks everyone. :heart:
kira: Quick note for postmortem: include timeline, config diff, affected customers, and mitigation commands. I'll create the incident doc at /incidents/2031428571 in a few hours.
incident-bot: Incident channel archived after final ack.
